fields.label: Allowed HERO Hosts
fields.description: One exact HTTPS hostname per line.

fields.label: HERO Source Instance
fields.description: Stable source-instance identity used together with ProjectMatch.id. Change only for a separate HERO source.

fields.label: Allow GraphQL Mutation Execution
fields.description: Global fail-closed gate. System Manager activation still requires an active schema-bound contract and explicit confirmation for every individual mutation.

fields.label: ERPNext Company for HERO Projects
fields.description: The single executing company for every HERO project. Customers remain separate target records.

fields.label: Confirm Company for HERO Projects
fields.description: Confirm the selected existing ERPNext Company before HERO project imports can use it.

fields.label: Polling Mode
fields.description: OFF never contacts HERO automatically. MONITOR reads and records only metadata. AUTO_SYNC requires active idempotent mappings.

fields.label: Polling Execution Window
fields.description: Optional local-time window; empty means no additional window.
